origins.name: Gun and Run
origins.description: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

enhanced.name: Pugilist
enhanced.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate improved melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.description: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

enhanced.name: Archer's Tempo
enhanced.description: Draw time substantially decreases after every precision hit for a longer duration.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.description: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

enhanced.name: Opening Shot
enhanced.description: Greatly improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

enhanced.name: Strategist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate improved class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

enhanced.name: Impulse Amplifier
enhanced.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.description: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

enhanced.name: Hip-Fire Grip
enhanced.description: Greatly increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

enhanced.name: Attrition Orbs
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage creates a slightly improved Orb of Power.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.description:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

enhanced.name: To the Pain
enhanced.description:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage greatly increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.description: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Offhand Strike
enhanced.description: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for an improved duration.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.description: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

enhanced.name: Cornered
enhanced.description: Faster charge time or draw time and increased stability when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

enhanced.name: Shoot to Loot
enhanced.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves. Increases range.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

enhanced.name: Swashbuckler
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage for an improved duration from melee final blows and defeating targets with this weapon.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

enhanced.name: Incandescent
enhanced.description:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Archer's Gambit
perks.description: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw-speed bonus for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Archer's Gambit
enhanced.description: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw speed bonus for an improved duration. Further precision hits extend the duration.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Surrounded
enhanced.description: This weapon gains improved bonus damage when three or more targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Harmony
enhanced.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for an improved duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

enhanced.name: Wellspring
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

enhanced.name: Adagio
enhanced.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for an improved time.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.description: Arrows explode after a short delay.

enhanced.name: Explosive Head
enhanced.description: Arrows explode after a short delay. Increases accuracy.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

flavor: "Breathe. Line up the shot. Enjoy the quiet before the kill." —The Drifter
